config_set_lines: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.2.1/24
set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-0/0/0.0
set security zones security-zone untrust interfaces ge-0/0/1.0
set applications application app-icmp protocol icmp
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-icmp match source-address any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-icmp match destination-address any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-icmp match application app-icmp
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-icmp then permit
